fields.quote: Musim ini berlangsung sejak 4 September 2026 dan dijadwalkan akan berakhir pada 5 Juni 2027.
fields.note: Liga Super 2026-27 infobox: 'dates = 4 September 2026 – 5 Juni 2027'. The sentence is cited to the official I-League calendar PDF (kalender-kompetisi-202627, 5 August 2026), so the day is the league's own scheduled final date. 5 June 2027 = 06-05; the asset's 05-23 was a class default.

fields.quote: Musim ini berlangsung sejak 11 September 2026 dan dijadwalkan akan berakhir pada 9 Mei 2027.
fields.note: ILI2 is the Championship (Kejuaraan, 2nd tier). Infobox: 'dates = 11 September 2026 – 9 Mei 2027', cited to the same official I-League calendar. 9 May 2027 = 05-09. Note the asset's start (09-04) is still inherited from the Super League, while this league actually kicks off on 11 September 2026 — that field is not in 'filled', so it was left alone here.

IN3L is Liga Nusantara (3rd tier). The 2026-27 infobox ends with 'ADT' (akan ditentukan = to be determined), so no closing date exists. The asset's 05-23 is inherited from IN1L. Kick-off itself slipped to 13 November 2026 (postponed from an earlier plan).
